Top Types of Men’s Runners Available

We offer a wide range of running shoes, designed to suit different running styles and terrains:

  • Road running shoes - Ideal for paved surfaces, offering lightweight cushioning and flexibility for smooth, efficient runs.
  • Trail running shoes - Built for off-road running, providing extra traction, stability, and durability on rugged terrains.
  • Indoor shoes - Perfect for gym workouts and indoor tracks, delivering comfort and grip on various surfaces.
  • Track shoes - Designed for racing on tracks, ensuring speed and performance.

These shoes boast sleek design elements and advanced features that elevate every stride. Available in a range of colors including grey, metallic, blue, green, orange, yellow, red, purple, pink, white, multi-colored, and black, there's a style to suit every preference!

What Type Of Cushioning Would You Like?

Cushioning on the sole would determine the comfort delivered. But this comes at a cost. Thick cushioning would mean a heavier shoe, which is not ideal for lightweight performance. With PUMA running shoes, we have found the balance between lightweight cushioning so that you get the best of both worlds.

How To Choose The Best Running Shoes?

When trying out shoes, keep these pointers in mind for the perfect fit:

  • Try on men's running shoes towards the end of the day as the feet tend to swell during the day.
  • Stand while measuring to check the width of the shoe.
  • Wear the socks(Opens in new window) or the braces you think you would wear while running, as that could change the shoe's feel. 
  • Walk with both the shoes on and move on different surfaces to truly understand the shoe's feel. How the shoes feel in the store is how you would feel while running. So, make sure you take your time while picking them.
  • Measure your feet beforehand and pick the shoe size that best fits you with 1-centimeter space in the front of the toe with half a centimeter space to the back of the heel.
  • Cushioning on the sole would determine the comfort delivered. But this comes at a cost. Thick cushioning would mean a heavier shoe, which is not ideal for lightweight performance. With PUMA running shoes, we have found the balance between lightweight cushioning so that you get the best of both worlds.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Which type of shoe is best for running?

The Flyer Runner running Shoes, Ultra Ride men's running shoes, and the Scorch running shoes are the best running shoes online.

2. Do running shoes for men make a difference?

Slip-on(Opens in new window) Running shoes indeed make a huge difference as it provides cushioning on the feet where it matters the most. The snug fit means lesser foot issues while ensuring flexibility and comfort of movement. 

3. Can running shoes be used every day?

It is advised not to use running shoes for everyday activities as it can damage the shoe faster than it was meant to last. Running shoes have unique midsoles that provide comfort and stretch after a run. Prolonged usage would mean the midsole would lose its properties to absorb the shock from the ground.

4. How to pick men's running sneakers?

Consider where you are planning to run. Plan the intensity you aim to hit every day and choose the shoe according to the duration of the run. Make sure to get your feet measured before you go to the shop and pick the shoe that genuinely fits your feet. Walk with the shoe in the store and have a good feel of the shoe beforehand.

5. How long should the running shoes be used?

By stretching the life of a running shoe, the quality of the materials is compromised. So, a good rule of thumb for changing the men's running shoes would be every 400-800km. Make sure you listen to your instincts and change the shoe when the time is right. Running is addictive when the runner and his body feel good.

6. What features should I look for in running shoes?

When choosing running shoes, consider factors such as cushioning, stability, support, fit, and durability. Look for features tailored to your foot type, running style, and the terrain you'll be running on.

7. What's the difference between road running shoes and trail running shoes?

Road running shoes are designed for running on paved surfaces like roads and sidewalks, offering lightweight cushioning and flexibility. Trail running shoes, on the other hand, are built for off-road running on rugged terrain, providing additional traction, stability, and durability.
